title.en: Estate Duty Exemptions — Asian Dollar Bonds — (Consolidation) Notification

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Estate Duty Act
(Chapter 96, Section 12(1)(c))
Estate Duty Exemptions — Asian Dollar Bonds — (Consolidation) Notification
N 6
REVISED EDITION 1997
(15th June 1997)
The Minister for Finance has approved the following Asian Dollar Bonds for exemption from estate duty:
(1)The P.T. Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia (Persero) US$59,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 1999.
[S 3/95]
(2)The Toyota Motor Credit Corporation US$750,000,000 6.125 per cent Notes due 2000.
[S 32/96]
(3)The P.T. Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia (Persero) US$159,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 1999.
[S 155/96]
(4)The SMC CORPORATION US$300,000,000 2 ⅜ per cent Notes due 2000.
[S 238/96]
